plugins.name: plan-build
plugins.description: An opinionated agent workflow for planning and building software changes: one approved plan, one fresh subagent per task, the project's tests as the gate, one review at the end of the branch.

plugins.name: resume-kit
plugins.description: An opinionated resume and cover letter toolkit: a Typst renderer with its geometry documented, an interview skill that records facts before any bullet is written, cold-reader agents for the resume and the letter, and a snapshot test that catches layout regressions.

plugins.name: purchase-research
plugins.description: A repeatable method for researching and deciding on purchases: name the real constraint first, compare on 1- and 3-year cost, and log each decision to one file whose frontmatter says its status.

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Design judgment for an existing UI: a skill and an agent that review or change a screen against the project's own tokens, universal practice (WCAG AA contrast on the real colour pair, hierarchy, spacing, restraint) and a taste file that is weighed, never enforced.
